question: Does an explicit causal-path/strong-incumbent scaffold improve concrete next-investigation decisions beyond a competent general expert instruction on development-selected Astra-derived packets?
actual_provider_version_tokens_and_money: UNKNOWN; requested configuration is not a usage receipt
intervention: Prompt procedure changes; evidence, answer fields and stated word/worker budgets shared. Inference token budget and sampled inference are not controllable; word cap is a reporting constraint, not equal compute.
blindness: fork_turns=none, supplied packets only, no tools requested; shared ambient instructions and model training are not isolated. Independent starts, not independent scientific validation. Source-aware investigator prepared tasks/rubric. Judge sees anonymized responses and task/rubric, no mapping until scoring frozen.
selection: Purposive retrospective, paraphrased, cue-rich tasks; development diagnostic only. No heldout tasks, no future-outcome prediction, no external scientific validation.
analysis: All assigned attempts retained; no rerolls. Missing/timeout explicit. Compare descriptive paired task means only, no significance or general prompting/discovery efficacy claim. A null/ceiling result rejects rollout justification from this pilot.
stopping: One complete 12-assignment batch. No adaptive extra task or favorable stopping. Sol methodological audit and blinded scoring before unmasking.
cost: 12 Luna calls plus review/source preparation/root and four or five Sol investigators; wall elapsed measurable, full token/call monetary denominator unknown.
operations: No messages to existing branches, publication, scientific code execution, workflow rollout or infrastructure changes.
